title: Streams and cout
prompt:
Ciel wants to know if you can keep up.

C++ prints with the stream operator <<. Read two whole numbers with std::cin and print their sum, exactly like:

Sum: 7

(when the input is 3 and 4).
hints: std::cin >> a >> b; reads two numbers. std::cout << "Sum: " << (a + b) << std::endl; prints them.
Replace the TODO with: std::cin >> a >> b; and then std::cout << "Sum: " << (a + b) << std::endl;
